statements.select:
SELECT A.COMPANY_CD , B.COMP_NM , A.BBS_CD , A.USER_CD , dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD)+' ['+B.COMP_NM+']' AS USER_NM_STR , A.BBS_RDATE , A.BBS_SUBJECT , A.BBS_CONTENTS , A.MENU_ID , A.USE_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_BBS_CMT WHERE BBS_CD = A.BBS_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS CMT_CNT FROM T_BBOARD A, T_COMPANY B WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.MENU_ID = #menuId#
AND A.USER_CD LIKE '%'+#user_cd#+'%'
AND A.BBS_CD = #bbs_cd#
AND A.BBS_SUBJECT LIKE '%'+#bbs_subject#+'%'
AND dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, A.BBS_RDATE, 112), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#sdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') AND dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#edate#, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY A.BBS_RDATE ASC

SELECT A.COMPANY_CD , A.BBS_CD , A.BBD_CD , A.USER_CD , dbo.FN_GET_BOARD_USER_NM(A.USER_CD,#language#) AS USER_NM , dbo.FN_GET_BOARD_COMPANY_NM(A.COMPANY_CD,#language#) AS COMP_NM , A.BBD_CMT , A.USE_YN , dbo.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, A.REG_DT, 112), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT FROM T_BBS_CMT A, T_COMPANY B WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.BBS_CD = #bbs_cd#
AND A.BBD_CD = #bbd_cd#
ORDER BY REG_DT ASC

SELECT 'BBS'+SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112), 3, 2)+dbo.FN_LPAD(ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, MAX(SUBSTRING(BBS_CD, 6,5))+1), '1'), 5, '0') AS BBS_CD FROM dbo.T_BBOARD WHERE SUBSTRING(BBS_CD, 4,2) = SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112), 3, 2)
statements.insert: IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM T_BBOARD WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND BBS_CD = #bbs_cd# ) INSERT INTO T_BBOARD ( COMPANY_CD , BBS_CD , USER_CD , BBS_TYPE , BBS_RDATE , BBS_SUBJECT , BBS_CONTENTS , MENU_ID , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR ) VALUES ( #company_cd# , #bbs_cd# , #user_cd# , #bbs_type# , CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),getdate(),112) , #bbs_subject# , #bbs_contents# , #menuId# , 'Y' , getdate() , #reg_usr# ) ELSE UPDATE T_BBOARD SET USER_CD = #user_cd# , BBS_TYPE = #bbs_type# , BBS_SUBJECT = #bbs_subject# , BBS_CONTENTS = #bbs_contents# , MENU_ID = #menuId# , MOD_DT = getdate() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND BBS_CD = #bbs_cd#
statements.delete: UPDATE T_BBOARD SET USE_YN ='N' WHERE BBS_CD = #bbs_cd#
statements.select: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(BBD_CD), 0)+1 AS BBD_CD FROM T_BBS_CMT WHERE BBS_CD = #bbs_cd#
statements.insert: IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM T_BBS_CMT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND BBS_CD = #bbs_cd# AND BBD_CD = #bbd_cd# ) INSERT INTO T_BBS_CMT ( COMPANY_CD , BBS_CD , BBD_CD , USER_CD , BBD_CMT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR ) VALUES ( #company_cd# , #bbs_cd# , #bbd_cd# , #user_cd# , #bbd_cmt# , 'Y' , getdate() , #reg_usr# ) ELSE UPDATE T_BBS_CMT SET USER_CD = #user_cd# , BBD_CMT = #bbd_cmt# , MOD_DT = getdate() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND BBS_CD = #bbs_cd# AND BBD_CD = #bbd_cd#
statements.delete: UPDATE T_BBS_CMT SET USE_YN ='N' WHERE BBS_CD = #bbs_cd# AND BBD_CD = #bbd_cd#
